meta.weeklySourceNote: Weekly predictions use frozen ESPN College Football Playoff Picture snapshots. Prior weeks never refresh after a new week is captured. Four classifiers and an ensemble are trained only on completed seasons before the season being predicted.
meta.modelEvaluation: Forward-season backtest from 2006-2024; each season is predicted only from earlier seasons. Probabilities are normalized across that season's top 25.
meta.weeklyModelMethod: Forward-season training: each historical season uses only earlier completed seasons; the current season uses 2014-2025 snapshots.
